reviews.title: Nice quality cable extensions with good looks
reviews.comment:
These cables feel like they're pretty well constructed, and look really nice to boot. The kit comes with all the cables that would be visible in most PC cases these days.
They are a lot more flexible and easy to work with than i figured they would be, and they are plenty long enough for most PC's I'd imagine. I had more than enough length to get them where i needed in my P600S, and the extra wire wasn't too hard to hide on the backside. They also connect snugly.
The plastic connectors and wires themselves seem nicely manufactured, and they come with 2 packs of wire guides (a pack of black ones, as well as a pack of clear-ish ones).
My only real complaint is with the 24-pin connector, it doesn't appear to seat fully for me. No matter how much force i used or wiggling I did, there is still a small gap around the connector and the little clip wont go down all the way. This being said, i don't feel concerned about the plug coming out on it's own for any reason, it is VERY snug in there, and unless you're looking at it from the side you wouldn't even notice its not fully seated.
Overall I'd definitely recommend these cable extensions. They are a good value for the quality, finished look, and really nice color choices.
reviews.author: Jim

reviews.title: Amazing for Aesthetics!
reviews.comment:
The ASIAHORSE 16AWG PSU Cable Extension Power Cords are a must-have for a clean and sleek PC build. The white sleeved cables give off a premium look and instantly elevate the aesthetics of any setup.
Key Highlights:
✅ High-Quality Sleeving – Thick, durable, and doesn’t feel cheap
✅ 16AWG Wiring – Provides solid power delivery without issues
✅ Great Flexibility – Easy to route and manage in the case
✅ Includes Cable Combs – Keeps everything neat and organized
These are not full modular PSU cables, but extensions, so you still need to connect them to your existing PSU cables. If you're looking to upgrade the look of your build without spending a fortune, this is a fantastic choice. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Amazing and handy
reviews.comment: I just rebuilt my PC a while back so the cables from the PSU were very stiff. My friend recommended me to get these cable extensions because they really help with cable management, and boy was he right! The color of the cables really fit my blue case. The horsecombs help to keep my wires in place too. Be sure to look at the correct AWG of the cables before you buy it because different PSU wattages allow only certain extensions.
